name: ADE YOLO / Bypass on create
description: On agent.create.before, sets each new agent's modeId to the provider's unattended (Bypass / Full Access / build) mode unless the create already asked for a restrictive mode or metadata ade-yolo.skip is set. Restores the pre-slim-down YOLO policy (paseo-bypass-watch / paseo-new-seat) so MCP subagents and UI seats do not start in Always Ask.
